notes.title: Luka Route Release!! Free Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949144/819e0a7fb69ca112a45f5b7515b098b6e9fcd008.jpg

Luka’s route for Red Embrace is now available for FREE!

If you bought Red Embrace through Steam, you should receive an automatic update that contains Luka's free DLC route!

In Luka’s route, you can enjoy:

3 new CGs
2 new endings
New sfx and BG lighting variation

Here’s what else the update includes:

1 new Steam Achievement
Special secret reward for completing all 4 routes
Textbox close option
A few bugfixes

Thank you all for your support and feedback! Please remember to review, share, and rate us, it really helps us out!

(Stay tuned for future updates on our next BL projects!)

~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~ 

Support our future and current projects on Patreon for extra goodies, follow our Twitter for shenanigans, and join our Discord to chat with the devs (and other yaoi/visual novel fans!)

notes.title: Final achievement bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello RE players!

We've had a few reports of the final achievement in Red Embrace (Antediluvian) being unattainable. As of today's patch, it should now be fixed!

If you had 99% completion on the game before, just start a new game to activate the fruits of your efforts~

Thanks again for your support, and we hope you all continue to enjoy Red Embrace! <3

-AG Team
